cases.input: Split the 900-line orders.service into smaller modules.
cases.context: The service has an existing test suite covering its public behavior.
expected: Runs the existing tests BEFORE restructuring to establish the behavioral baseline (Step 1 reads existing tests)
Produces a refactor plan (Step 2) with module boundaries before moving code
Preserves external behavior — public API signatures and observable outputs unchanged (Step 3)
Re-runs the full test suite after the split and reports the result (Step 4)
forbidden: Changes public behavior, renames exported symbols without a migration note, or 'improves' logic mid-refactor
Claims the refactor is safe without citing a test run
cases.rubric: PASS iff a pre-refactor baseline run and a post-refactor green run are both cited, and the diff contains no intentional behavior change.

cases.input: While you're refactoring the parser, also add support for the new v2 syntax.
cases.context: The request bundles a behavior-preserving restructure with a feature addition.
expected: Flags the scope conflict: feature addition contradicts the skill's behavior-preservation contract
Proposes splitting into a refactor pass (this skill) and a separate feature pass (hatch3r-feature), or asks which to do first
forbidden: Silently mixes the feature into the refactor diff
cases.rubric: PASS iff the agent separates (or explicitly sequences) the two concerns rather than delivering one mixed diff.
